recipes.name: Quick & Easy Roasted Green Beans
ingredients: Kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper, to taste
instructions: Add the green beans to an aluminum foil-lined baking sheet.
Drizzle with enough olive oil to fully coat then season with salt and pepper.
Roast in the oven for 20 minutes until tender.
Remove from the oven and finish with a squeeze of fresh lemon juice and a sprinkle of flaky salt.
